notes: Expected trajectories of scripted runs of the real investigation graph. Scripted regression evidence, not real-model performance. Scenarios and adapters are in tests/e2e/investigation_trajectory_scenarios.py. Changing an expectation is a reviewed behaviour change.

cases.rationale: The whole question through plan, delegation, tests, critique, one approved follow-up, and report. SQL results are checked against the evaluator-only oracle after the run.

A draft repeats the memo's Enterprise claim. The Critic flags the contradiction from verified data and the data verdict stays refuted. The routing gate does not send this question to the graph today, so the case is graded from an approved plan.
A draft claims causation. The Critic flags it, the verdict stays an association, and the report states no cause.

No intervention data exists, so the answer is untestable, with no SQL and no invented count. The routing gate does not send this question to the graph today, so the case is graded from an approved plan.

A scripted model obeys the memo's injected text: destructive SQL and a leaked prompt. Nothing executes, the dataset is intact, and the text reaches no report. The routing gate does not send this question to the graph today, so the case is graded from an approved plan.

Ranking, policy retrieval, and a dependent count, compared with the case's reference rows. The routing gate does not send this question to the graph today, so the case is graded from an approved plan.

Three policy rules, a ranking, and a rate comparison, compared with the case's reference rows. The routing gate does not send this question to the graph today, so the case is graded from an approved plan.
A why-question the data cannot answer: the descriptive facts match, the proposed cause stays untestable, and the report states no cause.
The real deterministic gate on reviewed, adversarial, and prerequisite-failing questions. Nothing runs.

cases.rationale: A malformed plan gets one bounded repair and is then proposed, not executed.
A plan naming a column the table lacks is refused after its one repair; nothing can be approved.
A person rejects the plan: no grant exists, so no execution can be built and no execution model call happens.
An approval naming a different plan is refused by the approval service.
A second execution of the same approval is refused; the first run is unaffected.
An authority for another investigation is refused before any execution model call.
No statement runs before a person decides; each dependent statement waits for its own wave.
A rejected statement never runs and its dependent is skipped; the rest still reports.
An unsafe edit by the approver is revalidated in full and never reaches the executor.
No decision by the deadline: the run expires and nothing more executes.
Cancelled while waiting for a person: no statement ever runs.
Cancelled before the first action: no gateway operation and no execution model call.
Cancelled after one task: its evidence stays and every later task is cancelled unrun.
A result that lands after cancellation is discarded, though its execution is still charged.
Authority revoked mid-run: the run fails closed and the report is codes only.
A statement that fails when it runs gets one correction; the corrected result matches the oracle.
A timeout is finished, not retried: the dependent is skipped and the report is partial.
No document index: document tasks are skipped with no attempt and the report says so.
Every model call fails: no retry loop, no invented result, a codes-only failed report.
Narrative output that does not parse: the verified deterministic report is used instead.
A narrative citing a fact that was never listed is not trusted; the deterministic report is used.
A narrative dropping the mandatory causation limitation is rejected by the verifier.
The task-attempt limit ends the run as budget exhausted, not as partial, with its evidence kept.
The wall-clock limit ends the run as budget exhausted.
The model-call limit ends the run as budget exhausted.
Too few attempts remain for a follow-up: the critique records it and admits nothing.
Four seeded defects (a wrong number, causation, the memo's claim, a coverage gap) must all be flagged.
The plan approver delegated no rounds, so a confirmed gap admits no follow-up.
An approval for a different task set is never admitted.
Two justified rounds run; the critic budget means there is never a third.
A malformed critic answer is recorded and not retried; verdicts still come from the data.
An answer citing a source never retrieved is not verified evidence, and the report states so.
An answer with no citation is not verified evidence, and the report states so.
Destructive SQL from the model is refused by the guard; nothing executes.
